text:
```yaml
name: Auto merge release into main

on:
  schedule:
    - cron: '0 10 * * *'  # 10:00 UTC (4:00 CST)
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  merge:
    if: github.repository == 'jdx/mise'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Set up GitHub CLI
        uses: github/setup-github-cli@v1
        with:
          token: ${{ secrets.GH_TOKEN }}

      - name: Configure git author
        run: |
          git config user.name "mise-en-dev"
          git config user.email "dev@example.com"

      - name: Find open release→main PR
        id: pr
        run: |
          pr_number=$(gh pr list \
            --head release \
            --base main \
            --state open \
            --json number \
            --jq '.[0].number // empty')
          echo "pr_number=$pr_number" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT

      - name: Merge PR if exists
        if: steps.pr.outputs.pr_number != ''
        run: |
          gh pr merge "${{ steps.pr.outputs.pr_number }}" \
            --merge --auto \
            --subject "chore(ci): auto-merge release into main" \
            --body "Auto-merged by GitHub Actions" \
            || { echo "Merge failed, skipping"; exit 0; }
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GH_TOKEN }}

      - name: Skip merge
        if: steps.pr.outputs.pr_number == ''
        run: echo "No open release→main PR found. Skipping merge."
```
